items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit Authorityは、New Horizons Baking Company(トレド市、Lucas County)に対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC、6年間1.199%)を承認。新規雇用45人・年間新規給与$2.3Mの創出が条件。
items.infer: 受領者名(Baking Company)と業種から、パン・製菓製造工場の拡張・新設投資に伴う雇用創出の可能性(推論)。食品加工用の生産・搬送・包装設備の需要が生じる可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.199% for 6 years on 2023-05-08 for a project in the City of Toledo, Lucas County. Commitment: create 45 full-time equivalent employees generating $2,300,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
